# Create a diagnostic object

<small>Source: [`man/HeteroDiagnostic.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/HeteroDiagnostic.Rd) · Help: `?HeteroDiagnostic`</small>

Create a diagnostic object that exposes `test()`, `plot()` and `summary()` methods. Formulas are accepted for convenience.

## Usage

```r
HeteroDiagnostic(model, data = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted `lm`, or a `glm` with the Gaussian family and the identity link, or a formula.
    The tests refuse a `glm` of any other family or link since 0.15.0.

`data`
:   Data used to fit the model when `model` is a formula.

## Value

An object of class `HeteroDiagnostic`.

## Examples

```r
 data(mtcars)
 m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
 d <- HeteroDiagnostic(m, mtcars)
 runDiagnostics(d$model, d$data)
```
